test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It is essential to understand consumer behaviour so that protective ______ can be taken through legislation.
solution:
The correct answer is **'measures'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Measures**__**: **An action that is done for a special reason **(विशेष कारण से की गई कोई कार्रवाई)**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- The government is to take new **measures** to reduce inflation.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **'measures'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

__
 
• **Method**__**: **A way of doing something **(रीति, विधि)**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- What **method** of payment do you prefer?
 
 
 
• __**Event**__**: **Something that happens, especially something important or unusual **[घटना (विशेषतः महत्वपूर्ण या असाधारण)]**
 __
 
• **E.g.**__- This year's Olympic Games will be the biggest ever sporting **event.**
 
 
 
• __**Dealings**__**: **Relations, especially in business **[संबंध (विशेषतः व्‍यापार में), लेन-देन]**
 __
 
• **E.g.**__- We had some **dealings** with that firm several years ago.
 
 

22a:Ta50,

The correct answer is "**Matchless**".
